To **retrieve the interfaces** (types declared as `interface`) for a GraphQL endpoint, you can use the **GraphQL introspection system**. Here are a few typical ways to do so:

---

## 1. GraphQL Introspection Query

You can use a GraphQL introspection query to list all **interfaces**. Here is a query to fetch all types, filter by `INTERFACE` kind, and get their fields:

```graphql
{
  __schema {
    types {
      kind
      name
      description
      fields {
        name
        type {
          name
          kind
        }
      }
      possibleTypes {
        name
      }
    }
  }
}
```

After you run this query (using a tool like [GraphiQL](https://github.com/graphql/graphiql), [Apollo Studio](https://studio.apollographql.com/), or a simple HTTP POST), **look for objects with `"kind": "INTERFACE"` in the results.**

To get just the interfaces, you can typically filter client-side, for example:

### Example filter in JavaScript:

```js
const interfaces = data.__schema.types.filter(t => t.kind === 'INTERFACE');
console.log(interfaces);
```

---

## 2. GraphQL Voyager and Other Tools

- Use **[GraphQL Voyager](https://apis.guru/graphql-voyager/)** to visually explore your schema, including interfaces.
- Alternatively, many browsers for GraphQL have an "Explore" sidebar showing all types grouped by type/kind, including interfaces.

---

## 3. Via CLI (Code Generation or Introspection Tools)

For example, via [graphql-cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/graphql-cli):

```sh
npx graphql get-schema --endpoint=https://your-api/graphql
```

Then, open the downloaded schema and look for `interface` definitions.

---

## 4. Example Minimal Introspection Query for Just Interface Names

If you only want the names of the interfaces:

```graphql
{
  __schema {
    types {
      kind
      name
    }
  }
}
```
Then filter for `kind: "INTERFACE"`.

---

## 5. Libraries

- [graphql-introspection-query](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/blob/main/src/utilities/introspectionQuery.ts) from the official GraphQL JS repo.
- [Apollo CLI](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/cli/) (`rover`): `rover subgraph introspect` or `rover graph introspect`.

---

**Summary:**  
- Use an introspection query to retrieve interface definitions (`kind: INTERFACE`).
- Use a GraphQL IDE or visualization tool to browse interfaces.
- Use schema-dump tools to extract and sift through interfaces.

**If you provide the endpoint URL, I can show you an exact curl or fetch example!**
